meta.title: Add hashed outer join optimization
meta.body_summary: Add hashed full outer join implementation in the VM runtime and regenerate IR output files for JOB dataset and VM tests.

perf_labels.notes: Codex adds hashed outer join in VM with IR output regeneration; PR closed by author after tpch update fails, no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 16592 changed lines across 35 files, this is a large change by absolute volume, though most lines are test IR output updates. The PR introduces a new join algorithm in the VM runtime but was closed without merge, likely due to functional issues (tpch update failure) and lack of review engagement.
